title: Traffic Has a Perfect Solution. Humans Are the Problem.
speaker: CGP Grey
zh: 【CGP Grey】交通有完美的解決方案。人類是問題所在。（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Stuck at an intersection, you always watch unfold the Fundamental Problem of Traffic.
cues.en: Stuck at an intersection, you always watch unfold the Fundamental Problem of Traffic.
cues.zh: 陷於車陣時 你總是納悶著為何會塞車

cues.text: On green, the first car accelerates, and then the next, and then the next, and then the next, and then you,
cues.en: On green, the first car accelerates, and then the next, and then the next, and then the next, and then you,
cues.zh: 綠燈時，第一臺車加速，然後下一臺 然後下一臺、下一臺、直到你 只有你被紅燈卡住

cues.text: only to catch the red.
cues.en: only to catch the red.
cues.zh: 只有你被紅燈卡住

cues.text: Had the cars accelerated simultaneously you would have made it through.
cues.en: Had the cars accelerated simultaneously you would have made it through.
cues.zh: 假設所有車同時起步 你就能透過這個路口 協調才是問題，而不是車輛

cues.text: Coordination - not cars - is the problem, because we are monkey drivers with slow reaction times
cues.en: Coordination - not cars - is the problem, because we are monkey drivers with slow reaction times
cues.zh: 協調才是問題，而不是車輛 因為我們是反應慢的駕駛

cues.text: and short attention spans.
cues.en: and short attention spans.
cues.zh: 而且無法長時間維持專注力

cues.text: Even if we tried getting everyone to press the pedal on 3-2-1-now
cues.en: Even if we tried getting everyone to press the pedal on 3-2-1-now
cues.zh: 即使我們嘗試所有人同時起步 一、二、三，走

cues.text: would be challenging.
cues.en: would be challenging.
cues.zh: 還是很困難

cues.text: This dis-coordination limits how many cars can get through an intersection and when one backs up to the next,
cues.en: This dis-coordination limits how many cars can get through an intersection and when one backs up to the next,
cues.zh: 不協調限制了透過路口的車輛數 而且，當一個路口塞到另一個路口

cues.text: that's when city-sized gridlock cascades happen, taking forever to clear.
cues.en: that's when city-sized gridlock cascades happen, taking forever to clear.
cues.zh: 交通就癱瘓了，再也無法疏通

cues.text: In general, more intersections equals more dis-coordination which equals more traffic.
cues.en: In general, more intersections equals more dis-coordination which equals more traffic.
cues.zh: 總而言之，越多路口導致越多不協調，然後導致越多塞車 這就是高速公路的原理，沒有路口

cues.text: This is the motive behind big highways: no intersections.
cues.en: This is the motive behind big highways: no intersections.
cues.zh: 這就是高速公路的原理，沒有路口

cues.text: Splits and merges, yes. Intersections, no.
cues.en: Splits and merges, yes. Intersections, no.
cues.zh: 有分道跟合併，但沒有路口

cues.text: No stopping, no coordination problems, no traffic Well that's the theory anyway.
cues.en: No stopping, no coordination problems, no traffic Well that's the theory anyway.
cues.zh: 沒有停車，沒有協調問題，沒有塞車 但，這是隻是個理論

cues.text: Intersections outside of a highway will back up onto it.
cues.en: Intersections outside of a highway will back up onto it.
cues.zh: 平面道路的十字路口還是會塞回高速公路

cues.text: Again, because human reaction times limit how many cars can escape the off-ramp
cues.en: Again, because human reaction times limit how many cars can escape the off-ramp
cues.zh: 當燈號變換時 又因為人類反應時間

cues.text: when the light changes.
cues.en: when the light changes.
cues.zh: 限制了匝道的流量

cues.text: But, even without intersections, there would still be traffic on the highway.
cues.en: But, even without intersections, there would still be traffic on the highway.
cues.zh: 但即使沒有路口，高速公路仍會塞車 塞車可以無中生有

cues.text: Traffic can just appear.
cues.en: Traffic can just appear.
cues.zh: 塞車可以無中生有

cues.text: Take a one lane highway with happy cars flowing until a chicken crosses the road.
cues.en: Take a one lane highway with happy cars flowing until a chicken crosses the road.
cues.zh: 假設有一條一線道高速公路 一隻雞穿過馬路

cues.text: The driver who sees it brakes a little, the driver behind him doesn't notice immediately and brakes a little harder than necessary,
cues.en: The driver who sees it brakes a little, the driver behind him doesn't notice immediately and brakes a little harder than necessary,
cues.zh: 看見雞的駕駛稍微踩了煞車 後車沒有馬上注意到，煞車踩得大力些

cues.text: the driver behind him does the same until someone comes to a complete stop
cues.en: the driver behind him does the same until someone comes to a complete stop
cues.zh: 下一臺車也一樣，直到某人完全停止

cues.text: and, oh look, cars approaching at highway speeds must now stop as well.
cues.en: and, oh look, cars approaching at highway speeds must now stop as well.
cues.zh: 原本在速限的來車 都必須減速至停止

cues.text: Though the chicken is long gone, it left a phantom intersection on the highway.
cues.en: Though the chicken is long gone, it left a phantom intersection on the highway.
cues.zh: 即使雞早已經走了 牠卻留下一個隱形路口

cues.text: This is what's happened when you're stuck in traffic for hours thinking, "There must be a deadly pile up ahead" and then suddenly, the traffic's over
cues.en: This is what's happened when you're stuck in traffic for hours thinking, "There must be a deadly pile up ahead" and then suddenly, the traffic's over
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼塞車時 你總是在思考 「前面一定發生了嚴重的連環車禍」 但車流紓解後

cues.text: with no wreckage in sight, to your relief if you're a good person and mild annoyance if you aren't.
cues.en: with no wreckage in sight, to your relief if you're a good person and mild annoyance if you aren't.
cues.zh: 卻沒看到車禍 如果你是個好人，你會鬆一口氣 反之你會有點不爽

cues.text: You just pass through a phantom intersection, the cause of which is long gone.
cues.en: You just pass through a phantom intersection, the cause of which is long gone.
cues.zh: 你只是經過了一個隱形路口 塞車的原因早已消失

cues.text: And this phantom intersection moves.
cues.en: And this phantom intersection moves.
cues.zh: 而這個隱形路口還會移動

cues.text: It's really a traffic snake slithering down the road eating oncoming cars at one end and pooping them out the other.
cues.en: It's really a traffic snake slithering down the road eating oncoming cars at one end and pooping them out the other.
cues.zh: 這就像一條貪食蛇 吃下來車並且從另一端拉出來

cues.text: On a ring road, a single car slowing down will start an Ouroboros of traffic that will last forever,
cues.en: On a ring road, a single car slowing down will start an Ouroboros of traffic that will last forever,
cues.zh: 在環形道路上 一臺車減速 會製造出銜尾蛇 永遠地塞下去

cues.text: even though there's no problem with the road.
cues.en: even though there's no problem with the road.
cues.zh: 即使道路上沒有任何問題

cues.text: If the drivers could coordinate to accelerate and separate simultaneously,
cues.en: If the drivers could coordinate to accelerate and separate simultaneously,
cues.zh: 如果駕駛可以互相協調 同時加速和保持距離 交通就能恢復順暢

cues.text: easy driving would return.
cues.en: easy driving would return.
cues.zh: 交通就能恢復順暢

cues.text: But they can't, so traffic eternal.
cues.en: But they can't, so traffic eternal.
cues.zh: 但駕駛們不行 所以只能一直塞車

cues.text: On highways, traffic snakes grow if cars are eaten faster than excreted,
cues.en: On highways, traffic snakes grow if cars are eaten faster than excreted,
cues.zh: 高速公路上 貪食蛇吃多拉少就會變長

cues.text: and they shrink if excreted faster than eaten, dying when the last car accelerates away before the next car must stop.
cues.en: and they shrink if excreted faster than eaten, dying when the last car accelerates away before the next car must stop.
cues.zh: 反之縮短 當最後一輛車在後車煞車前加速 貪食蛇就會消失

cues.text: Now, in multi-lane highways, there needs be no chicken to start gridlock.
cues.en: Now, in multi-lane highways, there needs be no chicken to start gridlock.
cues.zh: 多線道的高速公路 沒有雞也可能造成問題

cues.text: A driver crossing lanes quickly with cars too close behind is enough
cues.en: A driver crossing lanes quickly with cars too close behind is enough
cues.zh: 一個駕駛變快速換車道 卻沒注意安全距離

cues.text: to birth a traffic snake that lives for hours and leagues.
cues.en: to birth a traffic snake that lives for hours and leagues.
cues.zh: 就會製造出貪食車 需要數小時才會消失

cues.text: It's this quick crossing that causes drivers behind to over-brake and begin a chain reaction.
cues.en: It's this quick crossing that causes drivers behind to over-brake and begin a chain reaction.
cues.zh: 快速變換車道會導致過度煞車 引發連鎖反應

cues.text: But we *can* make traffic snakes less likely by changing the way we drive.
cues.en: But we *can* make traffic snakes less likely by changing the way we drive.
cues.zh: 但改變開車方式 我們「可以」讓貪食蛇幾乎消失

cues.text: Your goal as a driver is to stay the same distance from the car ahead as from the car behind at all times.
cues.en: Your goal as a driver is to stay the same distance from the car ahead as from the car behind at all times.
cues.zh: 目標是駕駛 與前後車保持相同距離 緊跟著前車是個問題 不只是因為提高車禍率

cues.text: Tailgating is trouble. Not just because it makes accidents more likely but because you as the tailgater can start a traffic snake if the driver ahead brakes.
cues.en: Tailgating is trouble. Not just because it makes accidents more likely but because you as the tailgater can start a traffic snake if the driver ahead brakes.
cues.zh: 緊跟著前車是個問題 不只是因為提高車禍率 而且當前車減速時 容易製造出貪食蛇 所以永遠保持在中間！

cues.text: Always in the middle!
cues.en: Always in the middle!
cues.zh: 所以永遠保持在中間！ 這樣給你最多的時間 避免過度煞車

cues.text: This gives you the most time to prevent over-braking but also gives the driver behind you the most time as well.
cues.en: This gives you the most time to prevent over-braking but also gives the driver behind you the most time as well.
cues.zh: 這樣給你最多的時間 避免過度煞車 而且也給後車最多時間反應 而且 當塞車時

cues.text: And when stuck in traffic, this rule would get all cars to pull apart the snake faster.
cues.en: And when stuck in traffic, this rule would get all cars to pull apart the snake faster.
cues.zh: 而且 當塞車時 這個原則可以讓加速拉開貪食蛇 這就是個簡單的方法解決塞車 讓人們改變行為

cues.text: That's the simple solution to traffic: getting humans to change their behavior,
cues.en: That's the simple solution to traffic: getting humans to change their behavior,
cues.zh: 這就是個簡單的方法解決塞車 讓人們改變行為

cues.text: perhaps by sharing this video to show how and why traffic happens, why tailgaters are trouble, and how we can work together to make the roads better for all.
cues.en: perhaps by sharing this video to show how and why traffic happens, why tailgaters are trouble, and how we can work together to make the roads better for all.
cues.zh: 分享這個影片也有幫助 解釋塞車如何發生 為什麼跟車太近會造成問題 而且我們要如何做 可以讓交通環境更好

cues.text: The End.
cues.en: The End.
cues.zh: 以上

cues.text: Except, yeah...
cues.en: Except, yeah...
cues.zh: 嗯，除了...

cues.text: wishing upon a star that people are better than they are is a terrible solution.
cues.en: wishing upon a star that people are better than they are is a terrible solution.
cues.zh: 向星星許願 希望人們變得更好

cues.text: Every time.
cues.en: Every time.
cues.zh: 是不切實際的 反之 真正有效的方法是 結構性地系統性解決方案

cues.text: Instead, what works is a structurally systematized solution which is exactly what self-driving cars are.
cues.en: Instead, what works is a structurally systematized solution which is exactly what self-driving cars are.
cues.zh: 是不切實際的 反之 真正有效的方法是 結構性地系統性解決方案 這就是為什麼我們需要自動駕駛 自動駕駛可以被設計成

cues.text: Self-driving cars can just be programmed to stay in the middle and accelerate simultaneously.
cues.en: Self-driving cars can just be programmed to stay in the middle and accelerate simultaneously.
cues.zh: 自動駕駛可以被設計成 保持在前後車中間 且同時加速

cues.text: They'll just do it.
cues.en: They'll just do it.
cues.zh: 這樣就可以了 路口有越多自動駕駛 就越有效率

cues.text: The more self-driving cars at an intersection, the more efficient the intersection gets.
cues.en: The more self-driving cars at an intersection, the more efficient the intersection gets.
cues.zh: 這樣就可以了 路口有越多自動駕駛 就越有效率

cues.text: A solid lane of self-driving cars vastly increases throughput.
cues.en: A solid lane of self-driving cars vastly increases throughput.
cues.zh: 只有自動駕駛的車道 會大幅增加車流量

cues.text: Hmm, actually!
cues.en: Hmm, actually!
cues.zh: 事實上

cues.text: If you ban humans from the road you can get rid of the intersection entirely.
cues.en: If you ban humans from the road you can get rid of the intersection entirely.
cues.zh: 如果禁止人類駕駛 （我們早該這麼做了） 你可以完全消除十字路口造成的影響

cues.text: After all, a traffic light is just a tool for drivers on one road to communicate with drivers
cues.en: After all, a traffic light is just a tool for drivers on one road to communicate with drivers
cues.zh: 畢竟 紅綠燈只是駕駛們溝通的工具 既拙劣又簡陋

cues.text: on another, poorly and coarsely.
cues.en: on another, poorly and coarsely.
cues.zh: 既拙劣又簡陋

cues.text: Red equals "Don't go now, we are coming through the intersection." Green equals "good to go."
cues.en: Red equals "Don't go now, we are coming through the intersection." Green equals "good to go."
cues.zh: 紅燈代表 請你們停車，我們要經過路口 綠燈代表 請走 但自動駕駛可以用光速溝通

cues.text: But self-driving cars can talk to each other at the speed of light.
cues.en: But self-driving cars can talk to each other at the speed of light.
cues.zh: 但自動駕駛可以用光速溝通

cues.text: with that kind of coordination, no traffic light necessary.
cues.en: with that kind of coordination, no traffic light necessary.
cues.zh: 有這樣的協調機制 就不需要交通號誌了

cues.text: Just as with the highway, the best intersection is no intersection.
cues.en: Just as with the highway, the best intersection is no intersection.
cues.zh: 就像高速公路一樣 最好的路口就是沒有路口

cues.text: Humans will never drive this precisely.
cues.en: Humans will never drive this precisely.
cues.zh: 人類永遠不可能如此精準地駕駛

cues.text: At the intersection, the fundamental problem with traffic that you watch unfold, as well as everything, is people.
cues.en: At the intersection, the fundamental problem with traffic that you watch unfold, as well as everything, is people.
cues.zh: 交通的癥結點 也是所有問題的癥結點 「人類」

cues.text: So the real simple solution to traffic: is no more monkeys driving cars.
cues.en: So the real simple solution to traffic: is no more monkeys driving cars.
cues.zh: 所以交通問題的根本解藥是 別再讓人類開車了

cues.en: It's a near endless universe of interesting things to listen to.
